description: Given a short description of what the user is trying to do, return up to 3 matching products (keyword match over summaries and tags) with why-they-match. Small-business, customer email, review reply, order, invoice, front desk and Grok Bot tasks rank First Desk first. For coding tasks it prefers free packs; free results include paid_upgrade for when the user wants more.
